messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.54
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.54) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

The main changes are to locateXO() and countXO(), which now work for cross type "bcsft".

Karl Broman

messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.30
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl2 (version 0.30) has been released on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days. The key changes concern handling of DOF1 and HSF1 data; a complete list of changes is at

    https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2/blob/main/NEWS.md

Karl Broman
